function: No learned component performs the PHY function: RIS phase and power come from SDR and closed form (pp. 4-5); LLM is asserted, never specified or simulated (pp. 4-8).
notes: Excluded as no_learning, the first code that applies. p. 4, Sec. IV-A: "LLM can deduce optimized strategies for RB allocation and signal decoding order", with no model, training, prompt or result; RB allocation would also be above PHY. p. 5: RIS phase shifts use "the semidefinite relaxation (SDR) technique" and Gaussian randomization, and power control uses a closed form (Eq. 19). Simulations (pp. 5-8) compare optimized initial phase, random phase and no RIS; no LLM is run.
